recipes.title: Homemade Farfalle with Sausage and Olive Sauce
recipes.summary: Make fresh bow-tie pasta from scratch, then cook it with a savory sausage and olive sauce, topped with creamy burrata.

steps.text: Create a mound of flour on a clean work surface and make a well in the center.
Pour the egg yolks into the well in the flour.
Use a fork to gently whisk the egg yolks, gradually incorporating small amounts of flour from the sides of the well.
Continue to mix the flour and egg yolks until a shaggy dough forms.
steps.done_cue: The mixture should come together into a rough, shaggy dough.

terms.meaning: A rough, uneven dough that has just started to come together, before it is fully kneaded and smooth.

steps.text: Use a dough scraper to bring the dough together, then knead it on the work surface until smooth and elastic.
steps.done_cue: The dough should be smooth and spring back when gently poked.

terms.meaning: To work dough by hand, pressing and folding it repeatedly to develop gluten and make it smooth and elastic.

steps.text: Pass the dough through a pasta machine, gradually decreasing the thickness setting, to create long, thin sheets.
steps.done_cue: The pasta sheets should be thin and even.

steps.text: Use a pasta crimper to create a decorative edge along the long sides of the pasta sheets.
Cut the pasta sheets into small rectangles using a knife.
Pinch the center of each pasta rectangle to form a bow-tie shape (farfalle).
Place the shaped farfalle on a drying rack or tray lined with parchment paper.
Finely chop the pitted green olives.
Remove the Italian sausage from its casings.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
steps.done_cue: The oil should shimmer slightly.

steps.text: Add the sausage meat to the hot pan, breaking it apart with a spatula.
Cook the sausage until it is browned and crumbled.
steps.done_cue: The sausage should be fully cooked through and no longer pink.

steps.text: Add the chopped green olives to the pan with the sausage and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
steps.done_cue: Small bubbles should appear on the surface of the liquid.

terms.meaning: To cook food in liquid just below the boiling point, with small bubbles gently breaking the surface.

steps.text: Meanwhile, bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil.
steps.done_cue: The water should have large, continuous bubbles.

steps.text: Add the fresh farfalle pasta to the boiling water and cook until al dente.
steps.done_cue: The pasta should be tender but still firm to the bite.

terms.meaning: Italian for 'to the tooth', meaning pasta that is cooked through but still firm when bitten.

steps.text: Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked pasta directly from the pot to the pan with the sausage and olive sauce.
Squeeze the juice from half a lemon over the pasta and sauce.
Add the pats of butter to the pan.
Toss the pasta, sauce, lemon juice, and butter together until well combined and the butter has melted.
Serve the pasta onto a plate.
Top with spoonfuls of burrata cheese.
Garnish with fresh oregano sprigs.

recipes.title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
recipes.summary: A miniature recipe for spaghetti and meatballs, featuring homemade meatballs baked in the oven and a quick vegetable sauce.

steps.text: Place the ground beef in a small bowl.
Finely chop the garlic and add it to the ground beef.
Finely chop the onion and add it to the ground beef.
Add pepper and salt to the ground beef mixture.
Mix the ground beef mixture thoroughly with a tiny fork until well combined.
steps.done_cue: The ingredients are evenly distributed throughout the meat.

steps.text: Form the mixture into small, round meatballs and place them on a foil-lined baking tray.
Brush olive oil over each meatball.
Bake the meatballs in the oven until they are cooked through and browned.
steps.done_cue: The meatballs are firm and no longer pink inside.

steps.text: Light a burner and place a small pot with water on it.
Add salt to the water and bring it to a boil.
steps.done_cue: The water is bubbling rapidly.

steps.text: Add spaghetti to the boiling water, cover the pot, and boil for 20 minutes.
steps.done_cue: The pasta is tender but still firm to the bite.

steps.text: While the pasta cooks, chop the tomato into small pieces.
Chop the scallion into small pieces.
Peel and chop the carrot into small pieces.
Heat cooking oil in a small pan on the burner.
Add the chopped garlic and onion (from the ground beef preparation) to the pan and sauté.
steps.done_cue: The garlic and onion are fragrant and slightly softened.

terms.meaning: To cook food quickly in a small amount of fat over high heat.

steps.text: Add the chopped tomato, scallion, and carrot to the pan and sauté with the garlic and onion.
steps.done_cue: The vegetables are slightly softened and the tomato has broken down a bit.

steps.text: Add pepper and salt to the vegetables in the pan.
Stir the vegetables and sauce mixture in the pan.
Add the cooked meatballs to the pan with the sauce and vegetables.
Stir to combine the meatballs with the sauce, ensuring they are well coated.
Remove the cooked spaghetti from the pot using tongs and arrange it on a serving plate.
Spoon the meatballs and sauce mixture over the spaghetti.
Garnish with basil.
Garnish with cheese powder.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
recipes.summary: A popular restaurant-style lentil dish, cooked until soft and then tempered with aromatic spices and herbs.

steps.text: Add toor dal, masoor dal, 1/4 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil, and 1.5 cups water to a pressure cooker.
Close the pressure cooker and cook for five whistles.
steps.done_cue: The dal is cooked well and soft.

steps.text: Open the pressure cooker and add 1 cup of water to adjust the dal's consistency, stirring well.
Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a large pan.

terms.meaning: Clarified butter, often used in Indian cooking for its rich flavor.

steps.text: Add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, 1 bay leaf, a pinch of hing, and 2 dried red chillies to the hot ghee.
steps.done_cue: The spices splutter and become fragrant.

terms.meaning: When spices sizzle and pop in hot oil, releasing their aroma.

steps.text: Add crushed garlic, crushed ginger, and slit green chilli to the pan and sauté well.
steps.done_cue: The garlic and ginger turn light golden and aromatic.

steps.text: Add finely chopped onion to the pan and sauté until golden brown.
steps.done_cue: The onions turn golden brown.

steps.text: Add 1/4 tsp turmeric powder, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 1/2 tsp coriander powder, and 1/2 tsp salt to the pan.
steps.done_cue: The spices turn aromatic.

steps.text: Add finely chopped tomato to the pan and sauté until soft and mushy.
Pour the cooked dal from the pressure cooker into the pan with the sautéed tempering.
Mix well and adjust the consistency of the dal as needed.
Simmer the dal for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to absorb.
Add 2 tbsp finely chopped fresh coriander, 1 tsp crushed kasuri methi, and 1/4 tsp garam masala to the dal and mix well.
For the final tempering, heat 1 tsp ghee in a small tadka pan.

terms.meaning: A small pan used for tempering spices in hot oil or ghee.

steps.text: Add 1/2 tsp cumin seeds, a pinch of hing, 1 dried red chilli, 1/4 tsp chilli powder, and 1 tsp finely chopped fresh coriander to the hot ghee.
steps.done_cue: The tempering splutters and becomes aromatic.

steps.text: Pour the spluttering tempering over the prepared dal.

recipes.title: Indian Style Egg Fried Rice with Omelette Parcel and Sauce
recipes.summary: A flavorful Indian-Chinese fusion egg fried rice, served with a savory sauce and wrapped in a thin omelette parcel.
equipment: Large wok or frying pan (for fried rice)

steps.text: Chop all vegetables: cabbage, onions, carrots, green bell pepper, green chilies, green beans, ginger, and garlic. Ensure cuts match the size of rice grains for even cooking.
Soak sella basmati rice in water for 20 minutes.
Bring a pot of water to a vigorous boil. Add salt to taste and 1/2 tbsp of oil to the boiling water.
steps.done_cue: Water is vigorously boiling.

steps.text: Add the soaked rice to the vigorously boiling water. Cook until the rice is perfectly cooked and not sticky.
steps.done_cue: Rice is cooked through and separate, not sticky.

steps.text: Drain the cooked rice and spread it evenly on a tray. Chill in the fridge for 1 1/2 hours to make it firm for frying.
steps.done_cue: Rice is cool and firm.

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
steps.done_cue: Oil is shimmering slightly.

steps.text: Add chopped garlic and ginger to the hot oil. Sauté until fragrant.
Add finely chopped carrots and cabbage to the pan. Stir-fry until they start to soften slightly.
steps.done_cue: Vegetables are slightly softened.

steps.text: Season with salt to taste and 1/2 tsp of sugar. Continue to stir-fry until the vegetables release their moisture and get a slightly darker shade.
steps.done_cue: Vegetables are slightly caramelized and a shade darker.

steps.text: Add chopped green chilies and 1/2 tsp of vinegar. Stir well.
Create a space in the center of the pan. Crack 3 eggs directly into the space and scramble them, mixing with the vegetables.
steps.done_cue: Eggs are cooked and mixed with vegetables.

steps.text: Add chopped French beans to the pan. Stir-fry for a minute.
Add the chilled cooked rice to the pan. Gently fold the rice with the vegetables and eggs, ensuring not to break the rice grains.
steps.done_cue: All ingredients are well combined.

steps.text: Pour 1 1/2 tsp of light soy sauce and sprinkle 1 tsp of white pepper powder over the fried rice. Continue to gently fold.
Add chopped spring onion and 1/2 tsp of white sesame seeds (optional). Give it a final gentle mix.
steps.done_cue: Fried rice is thoroughly mixed and heated through.

steps.text: Prepare the sauce mixture: In a bowl, combine 1/2 tbsp vinegar, 2 tbsp light soy sauce, 2 tbsp tomato ketchup, 1 tbsp green chili sauce, 1 cup water (or chicken stock), and 1/2 tsp sugar. Mix well.
steps.done_cue: All sauce ingredients are combined.

steps.text: Heat a small saucepan with a little oil. Add chopped green chili, capsicum, onion, ginger, and garlic. Sauté briefly until vegetables are slightly softened but not fully cooked.
steps.done_cue: Vegetables are slightly tender.

steps.text: Pour the prepared sauce mixture into the saucepan with the sautéed vegetables. Bring to a simmer and thicken with a cornstarch slurry until it reaches desired consistency.
For the omelette, crack 3 eggs into a bowl. Add 2-3 tbsp water, salt to taste, and finely chopped coriander leaves. Whisk until well combined.
steps.done_cue: Egg mixture is smooth and frothy.

steps.text: Heat a small frying pan with a little oil over medium-low heat. Pour a thin layer of the egg mixture into the pan, tilting to spread it evenly. Cook until set.
steps.done_cue: Omelette is cooked through and easily separates from the pan.

steps.text: Carefully remove the thin omelette from the pan and let it cool slightly to make it easier to handle.
steps.done_cue: Omelette is cool enough to touch without breaking.

steps.text: To assemble the omelette parcel, place the cooled omelette into a small bowl, shaping it to form a cup. Fill the omelette cup with the prepared sauce.
Carefully fold the edges of the omelette over the sauce to create a parcel.
steps.done_cue: Omelette is fully enclosed around the sauce.

steps.text: Serve the fried rice mounded on a plate. Carefully place the egg parcel on top of the fried rice.
Cut the omelette parcel open to release the sauce over the fried rice. Garnish with a coriander sprig and white sesame seeds.

tips: Always chop vegetables before cooking Indo-Chinese cuisine.
Cut vegetables to match the size of the main ingredient (rice grains) for even cooking.
Adding a little oil to the rice water prevents grains from sticking together.
